channel.title: Madeira through my eyes
channel.description: Igor Kartuzov, an entrepreneur in Funchal, is writing a science-fiction novel about Madeira. The diary: how the work goes and which places on the island make it into the chapters. Twice a week.

item.title: Gone for two weeks to write a book about Madeira
item.description: I'm 56, I'm an entrepreneur, and today I left for two weeks to write a book about Madeira.
